verdict.rationale: Honeycomb lets users define Triggers and SLO burn alerts on query thresholds. These automatically fire notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Teams, or custom webhooks, with templated JSON payloads using variables and Go functions, and triggers can be managed through the API and MCP tools. However, the only automatic action is sending an alert or webhook, so doing anything beyond notifying requires an external service to receive and act on the payload. Missing for 10: native action or workflow execution beyond notifications, per-event rules rather than aggregate threshold conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of trigger-driven automation.
